title: HoB2 exhibits a large magnetocaloric response near 15 K
summary: Machine learning guided selection of HoB2, followed by synthesis and magnetic measurements. The paper reports a magnetic entropy change of 40.1 J kg−1 K−1 for a 5 T field change near a 15 K ferromagnetic transition. The compound was known; the reported discovery is its measured magnetocaloric response, not a demonstrated refrigerator.
organization: National Institute for Materials Science; University of Tsukuba

evidence.tested: The source reports the study-specific result summarized here.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication and broader deployment or clinical benefit are not established by this source review.
evidence.ai_role: Machine learning ranks candidate compounds for measurement; HoB2 was then synthesized and its magnetocaloric properties measured experimentally.
